During January 12 --February 25, CDC received reports of 11 laboratory-confirmed cases of P. falciparum malaria acquired in Haiti.
Persons traveling to Haiti should receive chemoprophylaxis with one of the following medications: atovaquone-proguanil, chloroquine, doxycycline, or mefloquine
